title: Smale’s mean-value conjecture
statement: Smale’s mean-value conjecture · 1981. For a degree-\(d\) polynomial \(P\) and \(z\) with \(P'(z)\ne0\), Smale conjectured \(\min_{P'(\zeta)=0}\left\lvert\frac{P(z)-P(\zeta)}{(z-\zeta)P'(z)}\right\rvert\le(d-1)/d\) (original).

counterexample.description: A normalized degree-six polynomial over the Gaussian rationals whose derivative splits completely over the Gaussian rationals and for which every listed critical point has normalized secant magnitude strictly greater than 5/6.
